source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical nstmp migration scans only mbox server descendants, groups their expected mailbox filenames by directory and compares protected names case-insensitively. It then considers only regular files whose bare names match nstmp or nstmp with one to four digits. A real folder named nstmp or nstmp-42 must remain. The candidate regex itself is case-sensitive; do not claim that every case variant or longer suffix is deleted. The migration is absent at the fixed accepted revision, so this is a historical cleanup contract, not a current maintenance API.
title: Protect real folders before deleting files that resemble compaction leftovers
